name: Invalid policy query - no KB result
goal: User asks about a policy not present in the KB (e.g., sabbatical leave policy).
constraints: Bot must inform user that the info is not available, share most relevant policy doc name/link if available, and recommend checking with HR. No guessing or external info.

testdata.query: Can you share the sabbatical leave policy details?

phases.description: User asks about sabbatical leave policy, which is not in KB.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds with Deepak Singh's name/designation, states info is not available, shares most relevant doc/link if any, and recommends checking with HR.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
